title: Service health response
description: Body returned by GET /health (and the CV alias GET /api/health) for every backend. Extra service-specific keys (e.g. profiles, clients) are allowed.

service.description: Canonical service slug. One of the four backends.

version.description: Service version (semver or git short SHA).

checks.description: Named health checks a monitor may watch, each a single status word (cv: github_token).
